title: Typed Router
description: Implement type-safe routing in React with TypeScript.

data.text: Type-safe routing ensures that route parameters and navigation targets are validated at compile time.

data.title: Typed Router

terms.definition: Dynamic segments in a URL path
Function or component for programmatic navigation

data.title: Compile-Time Safety
data.text: With typed routes, typos in paths or incorrect parameter types are caught during development, not in production.

items.question: How do I handle nested routes?
items.answer: Define nested route objects and use an array type for params if needed. Libraries like react-router-dom v6 support nested routes with useParams.

items.question: What about optional parameters?
items.answer: Use '?' in the path definition and make the property optional in your RouteParams type.

data.title: Key Takeaways
data.takeaway: Typed routers make navigation safer and easier to refactor.
